blocks.content: 3. Diagnosing Real, Genuine Drift
Diagnosing real drift means comparing the plan's reported change against real, recent, actual activity, a console login, another tool, or a manual, real fix.
Real, cloud-provider audit logs, when available, are genuinely the most reliable way to confirm exactly who, or what, made a real, specific change.
This diagnostic step is worth taking seriously, understanding the real, actual cause shapes which resolution, covered later, is genuinely appropriate.
This connects directly to the real, honest causes already covered in the State module, manual fixes, other tools, console clicks.

5. Resolving Drift Deliberately
Recall from the State module, resolving drift means either applying, to genuinely restore the configured state, or accepting reality, updating configuration or state instead.
This real, deliberate choice depends directly on the diagnosis from the previous section, was the real, manual change actually a mistake, or a genuine, deliberate fix.
If the manual change was genuinely correct, updating the configuration to reflect it is the honest, right, real choice, not simply reverting it via apply.

Recognizing this pattern is worth doing directly, a one-time drift and a recurring, real pattern genuinely call for different, real responses.
